description: This file contains implementations for commit graph analysis and reachability algorithms in a version control system, likely part of a Git-like repository management tool. It defines functions for computing merge bases, reachability, ancestry, and branch point detection, which are core features for repository history traversal and analysis.

classes.name: struct contains_stack
classes.description: A stack structure used during commit ancestry exploration, holding commits and their parent lists for contains testing algorithms.

classes.name: struct commit_and_index
classes.description: Helper structure for tracking commits along with their index and generation, used during reachability analysis.

classes.name: struct contains_stack_entry
classes.description: An element of the contains stack, representing a commit and its parents during traversal.

methods.name: int compare_commits_by_gen(const void * _a,const void * _b)
methods.description: Compare two commits based on their graph generation numbers and timestamps.

methods.name: int repo_in_merge_bases_many(struct repository * r,struct commit * commit,int nr_reference,struct commit ** reference,int ignore_missing_commits)
methods.description: Determine if a commit is an ancestor of any of a set of commits (more than one).

methods.name: get_merge_bases_many
methods.description: Compute the common ancestors (merge bases) for multiple commits efficiently.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * reduce_heads(struct commit_list * heads)
methods.description: Reduce a list of branch heads to a subset of independent commits by removing redundant ancestors.

methods.name: int get_branch_base_for_tip(struct repository * r,struct commit * tip,struct commit ** bases,size_t bases_nr)
methods.description: Find the best common ancestor (merge base) between a tip commit and a set of branch bases, often used for determining the point where a branch diverged.

methods.name: int commit_contains(struct ref_filter * filter,struct commit * commit,struct commit_list * list,struct contains_cache * cache)
methods.description: Check if a commit contains (is descended from) one or more specified commits or tags.
